extracted.name: Crock Pot Party Meatballs
extracted.description: Meatballs are simmered in chili sauce, whole berry cranberry sauce, and lemon juice in this slow cooker appetizer that's a hit at parties.
ingredient_lines: 1 (14.5 ounce) can whole berry cranberry sauce
2 drops hot sauce (such as Tabasco®), or more to taste
instruction_lines: Place meatballs, cranberry sauce, chili sauce, lemon juice, and hot sauce in a slow cooker; stir to evenly distribute sauce.
Cook on High until meatballs completely thawed and hot, about 3 hours.
